allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Replace registration JWT with email-based OTP flow

Tenants are now identified by email on verify-email and resend-verification
instead of a short-lived registration JWT. This makes the flow resilient to
browser crashes and tab closes, matching the approach used by Supabase / Auth0.

Changes:
- RegisterTenantResponse: returns { email, subdomain } instead of registrationToken
- VerifyEmailCommand: Email replaces RegistrationToken; tenant looked up by
  normalized email instead of JWT decoding
- VerifyEmailCommandHandler: adds IP-based rate limit \(verify-email:{ip},
  5 attempts per 10 min\) before DB lookup
- ResendVerificationCommand: Email replaces RegistrationToken
- ResendVerificationCommandHandler: tenant looked up by email; ITokenService
  dependency removed entirely
- ITokenService: GenerateRegistrationToken and GetTenantIdFromRegistrationToken
  removed — interface now has only GenerateAccessToken and GenerateRefreshToken
- TokenService: corresponding implementations removed
- RegistrationController: ExtractBearerToken\(\) helper removed; VerifyEmail and
  ResendVerification now accept { email, code } / { email } body DTOs
- appsettings.json: add MaxVerifyEmailAttemptsPerWindow and VerifyEmailWindowMinutes
- Tests: all handler tests updated to use email-based commands; StubTokenService
  slimmed to match new interface; TokenService registration-token tests removed
- CompleteOnboardingCommandHandlerTests: updated RegisterAsync helper to use
  new response shape

All 73 tests pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
